$ aeon policy list
mixed-command            command_access agent:alice                  allow  operator     no expiry
mixed-cost               cost_cap       all-agents                   deny   operator     no expiry
mixed-effect             effect_class   all-agents                   deny   agent        no expiry
mixed-expired            tool_access    agent:carol                  deny   operator     <TIME>
mixed-route              route_access   loop:nightly                 deny   operator     no expiry
mixed-skill              skill_access   lane-type:review             ask    operator     no expiry
mixed-tool               tool_access    agent:alice                  deny   operator     no expiry
mixed-trigger            trigger_access mcp:github                   deny   mcp_server   <TIME>
$ aeon policy list --type command_access

$ aeon policy list --type trigger_access
mixed-trigger            trigger_access mcp:github                   deny   mcp_server   <TIME>
$ aeon policy list --type skill_access
